earnings.title: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
highlights: Revenue growth range of 5.9% to 6.7%; up 50 basis points at the midpoint
Adjusted EPS range of $18.30 to $18.70; up 18 cents at the midpoint

quotes.text: Labcorp delivered another strong quarter with 7% revenue growth, continued margin expansion and 14.5% adjusted EPS growth, leading to a raise in our full-year guidance.
quotes.by: Adam Schechter, Chairman and CEO of Labcorp

items.heading: An inability to attract, retain, and develop experienced and qualified personnel, including personnel in key roles and critical positions, and increased personnel costs, could adversely affect the Company’s business.
